energy.title: 🛏️ Energy and bed (Season 0 rework)
energy.howTitle: How bed, food and energy work:
energy.how1: VIP players regenerate +1⚡ every 3 minutes on their own (+20⚡ per hour).
energy.jam: 🫐 Sapphire Jam active: faster regen, +1.3⚡ every 3 min (+26⚡/h), for {{min}}m more.
energy.how2: Daily sleep quota (resets at 00:00 UTC): 200⚡ (base player, 2 bars of 100⚡), or 450⚡ / 600⚡ / 750⚡ (VIP or holders, 3 to 5 bars of 150⚡ depending on perks and Farmers).
energy.how3: Daily food quota (resets at 00:00 UTC, 1 full bar a day): 100⚡ (base player) / 150⚡ (VIP or holders). Cooked dishes fill the day's bar; Moonlight Stew gives 8⚡ per dish (it counts towards the food bar).
